    About this Item

    • 【25m Extra Long Flexible Cable】​ – This LIKEEM caravan hook up cable comes with a 25-metre bright orange flexible cord with 8mm outer diameter. It provides enough length to connect your caravan or tent to campsite power bollards without needing to park close by
    • 【IP44 Waterproof Industrial Connectors】​ – This camping extension cable features a 16A blue industrial plug and coupling with an anti-drop lidded design. The IP44 waterproof and dustproof housing helps withstand rain, dew, and outdoor campsite conditions
    • 【1.5mm² 3-Core Pure Copper Wiring】​ – This 16A mains power lead uses thick three-core pure copper internal wiring for stable conductivity. It delivers consistent power transmission with low voltage drop, suitable for standard caravan household appliances
    • 【UK 13A Plug & Storage Carry Bag】​ – This caravan electric hook up cable is fitted with a standard UK 13A fused plug for direct home pre-charging. It comes with a lightweight oxford cloth carry bag for neat coiling, storage, and easy transport during touring trips
    • 【Multi-Scene Outdoor Compatibility】​ – This outdoor caravan hook up cable works with caravans, motorhomes, campervans, camping tents, and leisure boats. It complies with the IEC60309 standard, suitable for seasonal camping and outdoor touring power supply

    Product description

    The LIKEEM 25m caravan hook up cable is a reliable power connection solution for camping and outdoor touring. Featuring a bright orange flexible cord with 1.5mm² 3-core pure copper wiring, it delivers stable power transmission with low voltage drop. The IP44 waterproof industrial connectors help withstand outdoor conditions, while the standard UK 13A fused plug allows for convenient home pre-charging. A lightweight oxford cloth carry bag is included for easy storage and transport. Compatible with caravans, motorhomes, campervans, camping tents, and leisure boats, this cable meets the IEC60309 standard for seasonal camping use.
